question: I have no speed and gain control of an opponent's Avishkar Raceway. Does my speed become 1 right away, without a trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: start your engines! isn't a trigger, so your speed becomes 1 as a state-based action as soon as you control the Raceway, even one you took from an opponent.
expected.answer: Start your engines! isn’t a triggered ability. Increasing your speed to 1 is something that happens as a state-based action as soon as you control a permanent with the ability. Notably, this includes gaining control of a permanent with the ability that another player controls.

whyHard: Start your engines! reads like an enters-the-battlefield trigger, but gaining speed 1 is a state-based action that also fires when you steal the permanent.
